summary: Oxbridge Re Holdings Limited filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement on June 22, 2026, registering an at-the-market offering of up to $1,678,301 of its ordinary shares through Chardan Capital Markets LLC as sales agent. The filing is a routine shelf takedown under an existing S-3 registration; there is no acquisition, divestiture, tender, activist, or other special situation. The filing is a non-event capital-raising mechanism with no structural changes, no board recommendation, and no special situation triggers.
